title: Refresh native VIXEN witness commands for current GPU queue modes
body: The committed vxtrain6 reproduction README still told lane workers to pass --exclusive for native R6 and A/B/A, reserving the whole host and violating the current queue policy. I corrected those commands to --gpu-benchmark; derive or validate witness commands against the shared GPU mode rules so this stale mode does not return.

title: Use the canonical global queue in the VIXEN split-test runner
body: The runner hardcoded tools/with-test-lock.sh in its worktree, so its CPU and GPU suite halves bypassed the live queue and its updated GPU modes. I switched the runner to the canonical /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh by default; make every lane runner resolve the dispatch-global queue wrapper.

title: Clear stale VIXEN kernel pin overrides during reconfigure
body: The first queued configure used the tracked b40 pin but an existing VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE=7d14eb76 in build/wsl/CMakeCache.txt silently selected a different kernel snapshot. I had to reconfigure with -DVIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE= explicitly to exercise the tracked 7a2b1f1e pin. Make stale per-build pin overrides visible or self-clearing when validating the tracked pin.

title: Declare newly added timing locks in the VIXEN mutex gate
body: The capture-speed merge added the owned mutex in VIXEN/libraries/RenderGraph/include/Core/PhaseTiming.h but omitted its row from scripts/no-new-mutex.allowlist, so the first full Release build failed at no_new_mutex_check. I used the gate's documented --fix flow to append the UNCLASSIFIED row. Include declaration inventory updates with changes that introduce runtime mutexes, or make the gate workflow surface this as part of authoring.

title: Schedule planet capture states as separate GPU queue jobs
body: The default Application.PlanetCapture CTest loops over 12 states and two fresh processes per state inside one queue job. On the 8060S it ran over 47 minutes; CMake captured child output, so the queue's 2400s stall guard saw no output and too little accounted CPU during GPU waits, killed the job, and blocked the device slot. Although VIXEN_PLANET_CAPTURE_STATE can select a subset, the witness had to manually resubmit the missing state. Expose a per-state queue runner or individual CTest entries so each state is its own GPU job and the aggregate P-property gate runs after all complete.
